scope: All source surface/street-side parking polygons in the research census, core and 600m ring; excludes mapped underground/multi-storey/rooftop/building parking
remainingLimit: Other lots include orthogonal, diagonal and mixed regions; these were reviewed but have no measured row-region model. Exact source lots survive; occupancy and individual-space placement are estimates. No claim of full parking-layout parity.
